buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Service & Support

AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 3. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Duration of the service contract may be extended up to 6 Months beyond the initial contract (Subject of satisfactory performance and mutual consent). 2. Option Clause. The purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be order up to 50% of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increa se or decrease the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contract quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. Bidders are bound to accept the orders accordingly. 3. The said job shall be carried out by the contractor on all days catered is the contract agreement perio d including all working days, holidays and Sundays for the MES IB, Pune. The job shall entail the provision o f complete services for all personnel, guest and officers, permanent and attached administrative staff for t he complete infrastructure complex of MES IB. Minimum 02 uniform shall be provided by successful firm/ v endors to all deployed outsourced personnel. It shall include the services (total manpower is 12 personnel) . Read carefully scope of work, additional terms and conditions and additional required docum ents uploaded with Bid in PDF format. 4. The successful bidder shall make accommodation arrangements for at least 06 outsourced personnel at a suitable location in the vicinity of MES IB, Pune. 5. Contract Termination or Manpower Reduction Clause. In case of repair/renovation work at MES I B, Pune, undertaken by MES the bidder shall be given 14 days prior notice for withdrawal of manpower or contract termination. Thereafter, only 02 x Security Guards shall be retained and only payment of these 0 2 x Security Guards shall be made, and the remaining manpower shall be withdrawal. No payment shall be made for the withdrawal manpower during the period of such reduction or contract termination. .
